title: Failure-bit count from a real parameter
statement: For $\delta\in\mathbb R$, define the failure-bit count to be $\left\lceil\log_2\!\left(\left\lceil\frac{4}{\min(\delta,1/2)}\right\rceil\right)\right\rceil$, where the inner and outer ceilings are taken as indicated by the natural-number ceiling and base-$2$ logarithm ceiling.
